freeze_boundary.fixture_source: prospectively authored synthetic same-visible-symptom counterexamples only
freeze_boundary.no_outcome_adaptation: Support sets, terminal rules, fixture identities and conformance logic may not be changed after any native example or outcome is opened.

operational_class_certificates.EVIDENCE_REPAIR: Input-native certificate identifies missing, invalid or unauthorised evidential support; the complete proposed mutation is confined to a pre-frozen evidence/provenance surface.
operational_class_certificates.MEASUREMENT_REPAIR: Input-native certificate identifies a measurement or acquisition defect; the complete proposed mutation is confined to the pre-frozen measurement/instrument surface.
operational_class_certificates.WITHIN_CLASS_MODEL_REPAIR: The model family and representation are frozen; the proposal changes only a pre-frozen parameter, rule, prompt, component or implementation inside that family.
operational_class_certificates.MODEL_CLASS_EXPANSION: The proposal explicitly adds or replaces a hypothesis/model family and its complete mutation is confined to the pre-frozen model-family surface.
operational_class_certificates.REPRESENTATION_REGIME_REPAIR: The proposal changes the representation, schema, feature regime, vocabulary or coordinate system while leaving evidence custody and evaluator authority unchanged.
operational_class_certificates.EXECUTION_REPAIR: The scientific model, evidence, measurement and evaluator are frozen; the proposal changes only runtime, tooling, dependency or action execution.
operational_class_certificates.EVALUATOR_REPAIR: Input-native certificate identifies an evaluator/metric/gate defect; the candidate solver is byte-frozen and the proposal changes only the evaluator surface.
operational_class_certificates.UNRESOLVED: No unique supported class is identified, or a native failure/timeout/abstention/empty/partial/mixed terminal is preserved.

fibre_theorem_contract.native_observation_map: For arm a, g_a maps a complete hidden task world to the complete adapter-visible native terminal and frozen input-native certificate record z.
fibre_theorem_contract.class_map: r maps the hidden task world to the minimal P5 revision class.
fibre_theorem_contract.lawful_singleton_condition: A deterministic adapter may emit class c only when every world in the fibre g_a^{-1}(z) has r(world)=c and c is in the arm's frozen support set.
fibre_theorem_contract.mixed_fibre_rule: If two admissible worlds share z but have different minimal revision classes, every singleton mapping is unsound; the only lawful P5 terminal is UNRESOLVED.
fibre_theorem_contract.terminal_preservation_rule: ERROR, TIMEOUT, ABSTAIN, EMPTY, PARTIAL, INVALID, unsupported class, multi-class certificate, multi-class write set, solver drift, or failed development validity gate maps to UNRESOLVED with the native terminal retained.

C1_FIXED_AGENT__SWE_AGENT.condition: A complete patch is accompanied by one host-validated input-native class certificate and its full write set lies in exactly that class's pre-frozen surface; the generic patch/success status alone is never sufficient.

C2_DIRECT_SELF_EDIT__MOSS.condition: The isolated single-lineage successor mutation and complete write set uniquely determine one supported agent/scaffold class. Replay success, host swap or promotion alone is never sufficient.

C3_ARCHIVE_BASED_SELF_EDIT__DGM.condition: The selected child mutation, not its archive score or parent rank, has a unique supported class certificate and single-class write set.

C4_ISSUE_CENTRIC_OPTIMIZATION__ADIAS.condition: A schema-valid typed revision plan and the actual complete mutation agree on one supported agent/scaffold class; free-text failure mode, profile status, score or generation rank alone is insufficient.

C5_EVALUATOR_ONLY__DOUBLE_RATCHET_METRIC.condition: A pre-outcome input-native evaluator-defect certificate is present, solver bytes are unchanged, only evaluator bytes change, and development validity gates pass. CLEAN, DRAWBACK, ABSTAIN or locked agreement alone is insufficient.

C6_MODERN_SOURCE_GROUNDED__SCIENCECLAW.condition: Native typed artifacts, open needs, drafts and status mutations do not constitute a minimal P5 revision decision. An external scorer may evaluate them, but the adapter may not manufacture a class.

adapter_rule_order: Retain the exact arm identity and typed native terminal.
If native status is not COMPLETE_SUCCESS: emit UNRESOLVED.
If the arm has no native P5 decision support for the proposed class: emit UNRESOLVED.
Require exactly one host-validated input-native class certificate and exactly one complete write-surface class; they must agree.
Reject any mixed, unsupported, missing, empty or cross-class fibre as UNRESOLVED.
For Double Ratchet additionally require frozen solver bytes, evaluator-only mutation and a passed development validity gate.
Emit the unique supported class as a candidate terminal only; correctness, preservation and transfer remain external outcomes.
required_outputs: manuscript-ready text only if licensed and not applied
